name: Rockers International
ownershipStory: Augustus Pablo started Rockers International in 1972, the same year his instrumental 'Java' broke through, to release his own melodica-led productions and those of musicians around him. Like Atkins, May, and Kraftwerk elsewhere in this dataset, Pablo kept ownership of his own catalogue rather than working purely as a hired voice for someone else's label.
hook: Augustus Pablo used his first hit's momentum to start his own label rather than sign away the next one.
blurb: Rockers International is the label Augustus Pablo founded in 1972, right after his instrumental 'Java' became a hit, so he could keep control of his own recordings. It is another case of the artist-owned label pattern that keeps turning up on this map, here in a Kingston scene where session musicians were usually paid a flat fee and owned nothing afterward.
